facts.text: Caroline and Melanie expressed appreciation for their friendship during a conversation on 17 August 2023.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Melanie! It means a lot having you in my corner. Appreciate our friendship!
I appreciate our friendship too, Caroline. You've always been there for me.

facts.text: Caroline mentioned that they had a lot of fun at the Pride fest last year, which was attended by a group of supportive friends.

evidence.quote: We had a blast last year at the Pride fest. Those supportive friends definitely make everything worth it!
That was a blast! So much fun with the whole gang!

facts.text: Caroline suggested planning a family outing or a special activity for the summer, which Melanie agreed to.

evidence.quote: We could do a family outing, or wanna plan something special for this summer, just us two? It'd be a great chance to catch up and explore nature! What do you think?
Sounds great, Caroline! Let's plan something special!
